Author: alizea1337
Name: Keystroke
Punchline: Automates Keybound Brawler typing with humanized input, auto-queue and reward tracking.
Description: Keystroke reads Keybound Brawler prompts and types the answers for you, with humanized timing by default and an optional instant mode. Auto-queue loops with stop conditions, opens Keybound Coffers, tracks MGP/MGC gains, warns before the MGC cap, and offers global hotkeys and a compact in-duty overlay. Open /keystroke to get started.
Changelog:
New interface. A bevelled charcoal frame with a drifting cyan-lime-gold signal stripe, an icon
rail, and pages laid out as group boxes with cut-in titles. Checkbox rows, thin accent sliders,
inset fields, bevel buttons. The word being typed is shown as keycaps that press down as keys go
out, on the dashboard, the compact strip and the overlay. Six selectable accents; effects and
reduce-motion switches on the new "look" page. DejaVu Sans replaces Inter.
